title: MediaFileUpload
description: media.file-upload@1: the multipart/form-data body of POST /api/v1/:app/files (media.object.upload, namespace :app): one part named `file` with the bytes and its filename and type. The tenant's quota is checked against the bytes; the answer is media.file@1 (201).

file.description: The multipart part named file (filename and Content-Type from the part).
